policy.comment: Navigation and ordinary interaction are allowed everywhere. Only the action classes below escalate, and only off the trusted list. Put your own domains in config/local.json (never committed); an agent may propose that edit and you approve it in chat.

input.comment: Real input through macOS Accessibility (native/input-helper): trusted clicks and hovers for pages that gate on a user gesture (sound, fullscreen, native dialogs). Only the agent Chrome, and the window is fronted for the instant of the gesture. Needs a one-time Accessibility grant; `npm run input-helper:status` says whether it has it.

eval.comment: browser_eval runs on any page except these domains (and their subdomains). Identity, payment and banking hosts by default; edit to suit.

diagnostics.comment: Console and page-error capture runs only on development hosts: localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, *.localhost, *.local, *.test, private IPs, and the hosts listed here. Failed network requests are recorded on every host (invisible to the page).

network.comment: The agent browser records the traffic of every page except these domains (and their subdomains): request and response bodies of fetch and XHR, WebSocket and EventSource messages, and headers. It is kept in the browser per tab and leaves it only when a tool asks: browser_network, or a background job's own files. Secrets are removed before anything is stored: the headers listed, and any JSON, form or query field whose name (lower-case, separators removed) matches redactKeys.

jobs.comment: Background jobs keep a page open in their own window, record the responses that match, and heal it when it stops answering: reload, then navigate again, then reopen the window, then stop and say so. Page loads (scheduled and remedial) are capped per hour. Records go to <stateDir>/jobs/<id>/<date>.ndjson, removed after evidence.retainDays.

evidence.comment: Each visit and screenshot is recorded under <stateDir>/sessions/<session>/ with a viewport image; directories older than retainDays are removed at startup.
